## MiniMax H3 Director — 参考生视频 (r2v)

1. UNET 请使用 **ref2va** 权重（与 fl2va 不同）
   `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`
2. 在导演台参考图槽位上传 1–N 张参考图
3. 提示词中使用官方标签：`<Picture 1>` / `<Video 1>` / `<Audio 1>`
4. Queue Prompt

<Picture 1> is the sole reference image and the opening visual anchor for [Shot 1]. It shows one adult female high-fashion model and provides the only identity reference allowed in the video.
<Subject 1> is the woman from <Picture 1>. Her immutable identity includes the skull volume, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, nose, lips, cheekbones, chin, jawline, face width, facial proportions, and visible facial landmarks. She remains one continuous adult woman with one continuous 3D head and body. Hair, makeup, jewelry, clothing, lighting, materials, and environment are editable surface layers only.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target is a 15-second single-take luxury fashion film beginning from the visual state of <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> walks continuously toward and past the camera while her hair, color, makeup, jewelry, couture styling, materials, and architecture transform around the same locked face. The body trajectory, walking rhythm, inertia, eye line, and camera path remain continuous throughout. The video ends with a clean white frame after an abstract catchlight transition at 00:14.600.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] opening anchor and facial identity): fully_preserved - the identity, facial geometry, facial proportions, and starting visual state from <Picture 1> remain the foundation of every frame. Surface styling may change, but the face must remain the same woman.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], and [Shot 6]): fully_preserved - one woman, one body, one persistent 3D head, and one immutable facial identity are maintained across all transformations, rotations, occlusions, lighting changes, and camera-distance changes.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a photorealistic, high-end editorial fashion-film style with controlled studio lighting, luxurious material detail, and one uninterrupted camera trajectory. Highest priority is facial continuity. Treat <Subject 1>'s face as one persistent 3D identity across all 360 frames. Every frame inherits the facial geometry from <Picture 1> and the immediately preceding frame. A head turn is a rigid 3D rotation of the same head, never a front-to-profile morph. Do not regenerate, average, beautify, age, replace, or invent facial features. Hair, makeup, jewelry, clothing, lighting, and the world may transform only as surface or environmental layers. There is only one woman, with no background people, duplicate bodies, clones, or repeated figures.

[Shot 1] From the opening frame to 00:02.300, begin with an 85mm beauty close-up of <Subject 1> already walking forward. Her gaze is lowered. During the same uninterrupted step, she raises her eyes, blinks once, and rotates her left shoulder toward the camera while the camera makes a subtle tracking move. A moving light sweeps through her hair and changes its visible color in sequence: silver, black, gold, champagne, rose, then platinum. The right hand naturally rises toward the ear and continues through the motion. Hair may pass across the lens, but it never replaces or reconstructs the face. The walking motion has already begun before the first frame and never resets.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.300, continue without a cut as the camera smoothly pulls back to 35mm. Preserve the same stride phase, arm trajectory, eye line, and body momentum. Her fingers touch the earring, sweep the hair behind the shoulder, and lower as her torso completes a smooth half-turn. Hair changes through momentum-driven transitions: long platinum hair, bob, black waves, high updo, silver hair, brown hair, short hair, then long black hair. Couture styling evolves through seams, folds, and moving fabric: black lace, pearl satin, tailored suit, translucent couture, champagne silk, fitted evening gown, and a white sculptural dress. Makeup changes only on the stable facial surface. Her expression moves through neutral, curious, confident, slight smile, and cool gaze while the facial muscles and anatomy remain unchanged. She takes the next step during the half-turn. Black chiffon crosses the lens and retains realistic inertia. No freeze, pose restart, teleportation, or instant whole-character replacement.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.200, the chiffon clears to reveal an empty architecture of stone, glass, and textile planes. Keep the exact walking phase and body trajectory. The camera descends to a 20mm low angle, then orbits around her while rising. Each footfall synchronizes with a controlled change in both clothing and environment: white couture becomes metallic tailoring, black crystal, translucent couture, and precise minimalist tailoring. Mirrored surfaces may multiply reflections of the same scene, but they must never create another woman or a second identity. She walks while sweeping hair away from her face. Fingers near the face cannot trigger facial regeneration.

[Shot 4] At 00:08.100, the camera continues the same orbit and pushes toward a facial close-up. Her hand changes only the fringe. As her head turns, her eyes briefly close. Makeup changes across the stable face, and hair color flows through blue-black, champagne, copper red, lavender, brown, silver, rose, and black. A blink may change the eyeliner, the lips may change lipstick, and the hand movement may change jewelry or the neckline, but the eyes, nose, lips, cheeks, jaw, and face width remain identical. Use rapid overlapping style transitions around the locked face. Maintain one continuous camera path while the lens moves from 85mm to 50mm to an intimate 28mm view. A shoulder may occlude the lens; after the occlusion, reveal the same woman with the same facial geometry and body trajectory.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.600, pull back to a full-body view while preserving the orbiting momentum. The choreography remains continuous: step forward, relax the shoulder, bring one hand near the neck, glance sideways, turn away gracefully, show the rear three-quarter view, look back toward the camera, slide the hand to the collarbone, lower the hand during the torso rotation, and continue walking.

From 00:10.900 to 00:12.200, protect the identity above every styling change. Lock the skull volume and every facial landmark while the same head rotates through front view, three-quarter view, profile, and rear three-quarter view before the look-back. Do not invent unseen features during the back-facing portion. Move transformations into the hair, clothing, lighting, and environment away from the face. Keep the hairline and fringe stable around the same skull. When she looks back, reproduce the exact same cheeks, eyes, nose, lips, jawline, and facial proportions seen before the rotation and in <Picture 1>. Do not combine the look-back with a sudden face change, makeup reset, hairstyle reset, or dramatic lens jump. Once the identity is clearly established, styling accelerates again while hair and fabric retain believable inertia.

[Shot 6] At 00:13.300, let the walking step, torso rotation, and hand movement decelerate naturally. Couture converges into an elegant black and pearl-silver outfit. Dark silver long hair settles around the same face with delayed follow-through. Continue pushing toward a 50mm beauty close-up. Avoid a frozen poster pose. She turns toward the camera and gives a small natural smile. The facial geometry must visibly match the opening frame. At 00:14.600, push into the eye. The catchlight contains abstract color and material reflections only, never another face. The reflection expands into a clean white exposure. At 00:15.000, end on a pure white frame suitable for a Pollo AI or MiniMax H3 commercial-film bridge.

Throughout the video, exclude identity drift, face swapping, facial morphing, altered anatomy, face blur, duplicated people, motion resets, frozen poses, teleportation, instant costume replacement, melted details, slideshow motion, glitches, UI, text, logos, crowds, and black frames.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet luxury studio ambience with synchronized footsteps, soft fabric and chiffon movement, subtle hair movement, delicate jewelry clicks, and restrained reflections from stone and glass surfaces. No dialogue, crowd noise, or additional voices.

non_diegetic_music:
A 124 BPM luxury experimental fashion-electronic track audible only to the audience. Use dry percussion, restrained sub-bass, glass harmonics, and controlled string textures.
